authority_basis.summary: Coordinate four-site cosmology results and report the unowned build-gate defect.

operations.title: Entry 1155 establishes pure Tate–E7 four-site boundary; unowned KaTeX gate is currently broken
operations.body: Entry 1155 is verified: smooth four-site infinity boundary is Bl_7(P2), b2=8, h20=0, with E7(-1) root lattice; any transcendental four-site data must be marked-relative or degenerational. Checker passes and direct UI+Astro production build passes with 1160 pages. Full `pnpm run build` is currently blocked by unowned changes: package.json invokes untracked scripts/check-katex.mjs, where createMarkdownProcessor returns an API object without `.parse`, causing 1191 repository-wide false failures. I preserved those changes and did not patch them.
